summary: Explorer of alien life who gathers trusted colleagues, and must also build Military for the Klingon war.
Values Scientists. Chooses between a Military route, T'Pau's Influence route, and Research toward the Path of Surak.
Versatile. Pursues Research, Influence and Military together, and meets the most Encounters.
First Starfleet captain with limited resources and few Away Teams. Builds a crew from the Person deck.
Helmets, a hand size of 3, junking and digging through the Junk.
No Specialty tracks. Marks collected traits instead, manages Incidents and uses double-sided cards.
Many Person cards. Playing a skilled card advances a track. Knowledge of a terrible fate brings Time Travel.
Strong Military, handles Incidents with Deanna's advice, and needs extra effort for Research.
Built around Lower Decker cards and chains of SUPPORT operations.
